name: rayban-meta-sdk
description: Specialist guidance for building Ray-Ban Meta and Meta AI glasses software with the Meta Wearables Device Access Toolkit on Android/iOS, plus Display Web Apps when applicable.

interface.shortDescription: Build and debug Meta AI glasses apps with DAT and Display Web Apps.
interface.longDescription: Unified Codex plugin for Meta Wearables development. It routes between Android DAT, iOS DAT and Meta Ray-Ban Display Web Apps; verifies current APIs when possible; and includes camera, audio, testing, privacy and release guidance.
